name: Junior Volunteer Program
org: Sharp Chula Vista Medical Center Auxiliary (Sharp HealthCare)
what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital for at least one year, with one 2 to 4 hour shift a week.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 through 11, at least 14 years old, who have finished 8th grade and have a GPA of 3.0 or higher. Seniors are pointed to the college or adult program after graduation.
duration: Minimum 1 year, 2 to 4 hour shift once a week
deadline_text: Application window Oct 1 to Nov 13, 2026 (per the program page). Application packet due 6 p.m. Nov 12, 2026. Teacher evaluation due Dec 11, 2026. Results by email Jan 31, 2027.
how_to_apply: Use the 'High school volunteers (junior volunteers)' online application during the window. A follow-up email asks for your transcript and parental consent, then teacher referrals, an interview and orientation.
notes: The hospital calls this program highly sought after and competitive, and says onboarding can take up to three months. Health requirements after acceptance include MMR, varicella, Tdap, COVID, flu and TB testing. Contact scv.volunteers@sharp.com or 619-502-3606. The two official pages differ by one day on the close date; use Nov 12 to be safe.
